body:
# ShishuAI: AI Baby Care App for New Parents

I remember the first week I brought my daughter home. Between the sleepless nights and constant diaper changes, all I could think about was whether I was doing things right. New parents face endless questions: Is she eating enough? Am I tracking her growth properly? It hit me; there has to be an easier way to manage baby care.

## The Problem

That sense of overwhelming uncertainty is what led me to create ShishuAI. New parents have a lot on their plates, and there's no definitive guide for every stage of their child's early life. So, I wanted to build an app that would simplify baby care by combining AI technology with essential tracking tools. From growth charts to vaccination schedules, my goal was to ensure that parents could find answers quickly and easily.

## The Build / Story

Building ShishuAI was both thrilling and challenging. I started by diving into Flutter and AI libraries to create a user-friendly interface and powerful backend. I wanted parents to feel at ease using the app, which meant I spent countless nights coding while sipping on cold coffee. One major hurdle came when integrating WHO growth chart algorithms. The data sets were extensive, and I had to clean and validate them to ensure accuracy.

I must admit, there were times when I felt overwhelmed. I wondered if I was just adding to the noise in a cluttered app market. But the feedback I received from my friends who were also new parents kept me going. They wanted something that could help ease their worries about their babies’ growth and health. That was my motivation to stay the course, despite the struggles.

## Key Features

### AI Growth Tracker
ShishuAI includes an AI growth tracker that helps monitor your baby's growth against the WHO growth charts. Simply input your baby's weight and height, and the app will let you know how they compare.

### Vaccine Tracker
Never miss a vaccine appointment again. ShishuAI not only reminds you of upcoming vaccinations but also allows you to track what your child has received so far—all in one place.

### Personalized Insights
As the app learns from the data you input, it provides personalized insights based on your baby’s growth and milestones. It’s like having a virtual pediatrician in your pocket, guiding you every step of the way.

### Baby Log
Record those precious moments easily with the Baby Log feature. From feedings to diaper changes, this tool lets you keep track of your baby's daily activities, so you’re not left guessing.

## Real Numbers / Proof
As of now, ShishuAI has gathered around 1,200 downloads across Bangladesh, which may seem small, but it reflects a niche yet engaged audience. Early feedback has been positive, with parents appreciating how easy it is to navigate and its helpful features. It’s incredibly fulfilling to see that the app is making a difference for those few families who’ve taken the leap to use it.

If you're curious to see how ShishuAI can help with your baby's care, check us out on the Play Store [here](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shishuai.app). For more insights about our journey, visit [ofbuilder.com](https://ofbuilder.com).

## Closing
What’s next for ShishuAI? I’m targeting enhancements based on the feedback received, particularly around community support features, so parents can connect and share their experiences. Building this app has taught me the importance of listening to your users, even when self-doubt creeps in. In this maze of parenthood, every bit of help counts, and having parents trust us to be a part of that journey means everything.
